description_zh: 获取备份基础版统计数据
name: GetBasicStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. The valid value is:

ECS_FILE: ECS File Backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型。取值范围：
ECS_FILE：表示ECS文件备份
parameters.name: source_type

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful

GlobalStatistics.description_en: The Backup statistics for all regions
GlobalStatistics.description_zh: 全地域的备份统计数据

ProtectedDataSize.description_en:
The backed-up data size, in bytes.

When `SourceType` is set to `ECS_FILE`, this parameter represents the total capacity of backed-up Cloud Disks
ProtectedDataSize.description_zh:
已备份的数据，单位Byte。
SourceType=ECS_FILE：已备份的云盘容量

ProtectedResourceCount.description_en:
The number of backed-up resources.

When `SourceType` is set to `ECS_FILE`, this parameter represents the number of backed-up ECS instances
ProtectedResourceCount.description_zh:
已备份的资源数量。
SourceType=ECS_FILE：已备份的ECS实例数

Message.description_en: The response message. If the request is successful, `successful` is returned. If the request fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

RegionStatistics.description_en: The Backup statistics for each region
RegionStatistics.description_zh: 每个地域的备份统计数据

items.description_en: The Backup statistics for each region
items.description_zh: 每个地域的备份统计数据

ProtectedDataSize.description_en:
The backed-up data size, in bytes.

When `SourceType` is set to `ECS_FILE`, this parameter represents the total capacity of backed-up Cloud Disks
ProtectedDataSize.description_zh:
已备份的数据，单位Byte。
SourceType=ECS_FILE：已备份的云盘容量

ProtectedResourceCount.description_en:
The number of backed-up resources.

When `SourceType` is set to `ECS_FILE`, this parameter represents the number of backed-up ECS instances
ProtectedResourceCount.description_zh:
已备份的资源数量。
SourceType=ECS_FILE：已备份的ECS实例数

SourceType.description_en:
The data source type. The valid value is:

ECS_FILE: ECS File Backup
SourceType.description_zh:
备份类型。取值范围：
ECS_FILE：表示ECS文件备份

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败
